name: WorkerProfile
intent: Worker profile body: an optional identity region (photo, name, worker-level actions) over up to seven icon tabs (General, Certificates, Compliance, Trainings, Device, Crew, Visits — narrowed by the optional `tabs` allow-list, so a host without a Visits concept shows no Visits tab rather than a permanently empty one) and a label/value field list, for showing one worker's record inside a panel. Certificates and Device take caller actions in their tab header; Compliance takes either the typed model or caller-supplied content; a typed check reports the verdict the user picks and its upload intent to the host, holds no state of its own (the host owns `selectedOption`) and can be locked while a save is in flight, with an optional footer under the checks for a batched commit. Typed tabs take an optional per-tab loading/error state, so a tab-gated fetch does not read as an empty record. Every certificate can carry its own row actions (edit/delete) and route its document click through the host, for files behind the host's auth. The widget's own built-in text — tab names, empty and error wording, Retry — is overridable through `text`, so a localized host is not stuck with English. Panel chrome is the caller's — it drops into a PushPanel, Sheet, Dialog, or a plain column.
when: Showing a single worker's record beside a roster or map
A detail surface whose sections are peer tabs rather than a long scroll
whenNot: Editing worker data -> use Form + Field
Comparing several workers at once -> use DataTable

chooseOver.component: Hand-rolling label/value rows inside a PushPanel
chooseOver.because: WorkerProfile owns the tab set, field grouping, separators, certificate blocks, the identity strip, and per-tab empty states.

allowedPlacement: inside a PushPanel, Sheet, Dialog, or a column that gives it height
forbiddenPlacement: as a route-level page without panel chrome

extracted: grouped label/value field rows with separators
